summary: Verified load_dotenv(override=True) fix in canonicalize_aliases.py and ensure_search_indexes_v2.py. All 3 required regressions pass: (1) dry-run works with clean shell, (2) bug-repro with stale bogus MONGO_URL in shell env now succeeds because .env value wins, (3) ensure_search_indexes_v2.py dry-run works and lists index actions.
critical_code_review_comments: override=True correctly applied at line 44 in canonicalize_aliases.py and line 47 in ensure_search_indexes_v2.py. Consistent with fix intent.
Consider applying override=True to other scripts in backend/scripts/ that use load_dotenv to prevent same bug class recurring (audit_indexes.py, backfill_*.py etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Test results: (1) dry-run canonicalize_aliases.py -> 146,308 candidates found, DRY RUN banner shown. (2) With MONGO_URL=mongodb://wrong:wrong@localhost:27017/wrongdb exported, same successful result (146,308) — proving .env value overrides stale shell env. (3) ensure_search_indexes_v2.py dry-run lists text index, B-tree indexes, backfill count; also succeeds with bogus MONGO_URL. --apply flag was NOT run per instructions.
rca of the issue: Root cause: python-dotenv load_dotenv() default override=False means existing os.environ values win over .env. Operator's shell had a stale corrupted MONGO_URL from earlier `set -a; source .env`, which was inherited by python subprocess and used for auth. Fix: pass override=True so .env is authoritative. Verified by exporting a bogus MONGO_URL and confirming the script still authenticates using the correct value from backend/.env.
